sections.content: Data Science and Business Analytics undergraduate with experience in data engineering, analytics, and AI/ML application development. Skilled in Python, SQL, PySpark, Databricks, and cloud data platforms. Experienced in developing data pipelines, building analytical solutions, and deploying AI-powered applications.

entries.content: Built Python ETL pipelines integrating East Asia sales, order, CPQ, WBS, and opportunity data, reducing manual processing time by approximately 80%. Developed reusable SQL queries in Amazon Redshift for recurring operational reporting across business functions. Created Tableau dashboards supporting Finance, Offer Marketing, and Customer stakeholders. Implemented logging and error-handling mechanisms to improve data pipeline traceability and maintainability.

Engineered PySpark ELT pipelines in Azure Databricks, transforming raw multi-client policy and claims data into production-ready Delta Lake tables within Unity Catalog. Developed modular data transformations for schema harmonization, lookup enrichment, and data validation. Built an LLM evaluation framework combining deterministic matching and LLM-as-Judge scoring. Migrated a local application to Databricks Apps and integrated React frontend components with FastAPI backend services.

Migrated Tableau dashboards to Power BI to support retail analytics operations. Developed daily sales tracking dashboards with year-over-year comparisons. Implemented reporting improvements and conducted user training to support dashboard adoption.

sections.content: Programming: Python, SQL, R, JavaScript, TypeScript. Data Engineering: PySpark, Power Query, Informatica, ETL, ELT, Delta Lake. Cloud Platforms: Azure Databricks, AWS Redshift, Google Cloud Platform. Databases: PostgreSQL, Amazon Redshift, BigQuery, SQLite. Machine Learning: Scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face Transformers, MLflow. Data Visualization: Tableau, Power BI.

entries.content: Led a data analytics project involving the collection and processing of over 1,000 healthcare job listings using Python, BeautifulSoup, and Selenium. Analyzed salary ranges, qualification requirements, and job market trends using pandas and visualization libraries.
Developed machine learning classification models and geospatial optimization techniques to analyze traffic collision risk and prioritize ambulance station locations.
